Parents.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 For Parents & Teachers
Parents.whatIsText: JamboScript is a programming language designed in Swahili. It teaches basic computer science concepts through stories and games — children learn by doing, not just reading.
Parents.ageText: JamboScript is designed for children aged 8–14. No prior knowledge is required — the game teaches step by step.
learnItems: Telling the computer what to say (andika = print)
Teaching the computer to remember things (variables = boxes with labels)
Teaching the computer to choose (if this, do that)
Making the computer repeat things (loops = do it 5 times!)
Parents.safetyText: All code runs inside the browser only — no data is sent to servers. No ads, no tracking, no hidden charges.

Privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
summaryItems: All data stays on your device only
No data is sold or shared with anyone
Privacy.collectIntro: JamboScript stores a small amount of information on your device (never on our servers) to save your progress:

name.label: Player Name
name.description: The name your child types in the story (e.g., "Amani"). Used only to personalize the adventure.

progress.label: Chapter Progress
progress.description: Which chapters have been completed and how many stars earned. Helps your child continue where they left off.

code.label: Code Attempts
code.description: The code your child writes in each chapter. Restored when they return so they don't lose their work.

settings.label: Sound Settings
settings.description: Whether sound effects and narration are on or off. Just personal preferences.

Privacy.storageText: All data is stored in your browser's localStorage — a small storage space on YOUR device. We never see it, we can't access it, and it never leaves your computer or phone. When you clear your browser data, it's gone forever.
Privacy.ttsText: If you enable the "read aloud" feature, the story text may be sent to a text-to-speech service (Azure or your device's built-in voice) to generate audio. Only the story text is sent — never any personal information. This feature is optional and can be disabled.
dontItems: We don't require accounts or passwords
We don't use cookies for tracking
We don't share or sell any data
We don't use analytics or tracking tools
Privacy.childrenText: JamboScript is designed for children aged 8–14. We take children's privacy very seriously. We don't collect any personal information from children. The only data stored is on the child's own device and is fully under parental control.

ch1.title: Say the Magic Words!
ch1.subtitle: Tell the computer what to say
ch1.questHook: The magic tree is sick! Help Kito open the gate! 🚪
ch1.d1: Once upon a time, there was a village called Algoriti. 🏘️ It had an amazing magic tree 🌳 that kept all the village's stories and songs safe. But oh no! A sneaky little bug named Shida is making the tree sick! 😱
ch1.d2: Hi! I'm Kito the turtle! 🐢 I need YOUR help to save our magic tree! But first — see this big gate? Shida locked it! 🔒 We need to tell the computer to say the secret words to open it!
ch1.d2b: Hehehe! 👾 You can't get in! I locked the gate and threw away the key! Nyah nyah!
ch1.d3: Don't worry! I know a trick! ✨ Type "andika" — that's how you tell the computer to TALK! It's like saying "Hey computer, say this!" Try it:
ch1.d4: See? andika("...") makes the computer say whatever is inside the quotes! Put the magic words in and — BOOM! 💥 The lock breaks!
ch1.starterCode:
# Say the magic words to open the gate!
# Just press the ▶ Run button!

andika("Fungua lango!")
ch1.task: Press ▶ Run to say the magic words!
ch1.riddle: 🚪 The gate is locked! Press ▶ Run to make the computer say the magic words!
ch1.hint1: Just press the green ▶ Run button!
ch1.hint2: The code is already there — andika("Fungua lango!")
ch1.hint3: andika means "say" — it makes the computer talk!
ch1.errorGeneric: Oops! Something went wrong — try again! 🔄
ch1.errorNoOutput: The gate can't hear you! Press ▶ Run to say something!
ch1.outro1: WOOOOSH! ✨ The gate flies open! Golden light everywhere! The villagers come out cheering — someone is here to save the tree! 🎉
ch1.outro2: You did it! 🐢 You just told the computer what to say — that's your FIRST coding spell! But Shida has more tricks up ahead. Let's go! 🏃

ch2.title: What's Your Name?
ch2.subtitle: Teach the computer to remember things
ch2.questHook: The old man at the gate wants to know your name! 👴
ch2.d1: You're through the gate! 🎉 But wait — there's an old man blocking the path. He says: "Stop! I don't let strangers through. Tell me your name first!" 👴
ch2.d2: Uh oh! He won't let us pass! 🐢 We need to teach the computer YOUR name so everyone knows who you are!
ch2.d3: "acha" is like putting something in a box and writing a label on it! 📦 You put your name inside, like this:
ch2.d4: "acha jina = ..." means "computer, remember my name!" Then "andika(jina)" means "say it out loud!" — the old man will hear and let you through! 😊
ch2.starterCode:
# The old man asks: "What's your name?"
# Put your name between the quote marks:

acha jina = "Your Name"

# Now say it out loud:
andika(jina)
ch2.task: Type your name between the quotes!
ch2.riddle: 🏠 The old man asks: "Who are you?" — Type your name between the " " marks!
ch2.hint1: Change "Your Name" to YOUR real name!
ch2.hint3: Make sure you type at least one letter inside the ""
ch2.errorGeneric: Oops! Something went wrong — try again!
ch2.errorNoName: You forgot your name! Type it inside the quote marks ""!
ch2.outro1: The old man smiles! "Welcome, little one!" 😊 Now everyone in the village knows your name! You can keep going toward the magic tree! 🌳
ch2.outro2: Psst! 👾 So what if you have a name? I messed up all the signs in the forest! You'll get SO lost! Hehehe!
ch2.outro3: Don't listen to Shida! 🐢 The cool thing is — the computer remembers your name now! That's called a "variable" — it's like a label on a box. Super useful! Let's keep going! 📦

ch3.title: Choose Your Path!
ch3.subtitle: Teach the computer to choose
ch3.questHook: Shida mixed up the signs! Which way do we go? 🤔
ch3.d1: You're in the forest now! 🌲 The path splits in two! Left goes to a cave 🕳️, right goes to a river 🏞️. It's raining — which one is safe?
ch3.d1b: Hahaha! 👾 I switched ALL the signs! Good luck finding the way! Mwahahaha!
ch3.d2: Don't be scared! 😊 I'm Mzee Byte, the wise old owl 🧙. We can check the weather and pick the right path!
ch3.d3: "kama" means "if" — like asking a question! IF it's raining → go to the cave! Simple! Look:
ch3.d4: It's raining right now! 🌧️ So just fill in what to say: "Nenda pangoni!" means "Go to the cave!" Easy peasy!
ch3.task: Fill in the blank — what should we say when it rains?
ch3.riddle: 🌧️ It's raining! Fill in the blank: tell everyone where to go!
ch3.hint3: Any words work! Just type something between the quotes!
ch3.errorGeneric: Oops! Something went wrong — try again! 🔄
ch3.errorNoOutput: The kama block didn't say anything! Fill in the blank inside andika("___")
ch3.outro1: The right path lights up under your feet! ✨ Shida's fake signs pop like bubbles! The forest opens up and you can see... a big old bridge! 🌉
ch3.outro2: Great job! 🧙 You taught the computer to choose — IF something is true, DO something! That's really smart! But there's more ahead...

ch4.title: Step by Step!
ch4.subtitle: Make the computer repeat things
ch4.questHook: Shida broke the bridge! Walk carefully — 5 steps! 🌉
ch4.d1: You made it to the bridge! 🌉 The magic tree is RIGHT THERE on the other side! But... Shida chewed through the wood! 😬 Only 5 boards left!
ch4.d1b: I ate most of the boards! 👾 Nom nom nom! There's NO WAY you can cross!
ch4.d2: Don't panic! 🧙 We'll use a LOOP! Instead of writing "step" five times... we write it ONCE and say "do it 5 times"!
ch4.d3: "rudia" means "repeat"! It does something over and over. The number tells it how many times! Watch:
ch4.d4: See that number 5? That's how many steps we take! The loop says "do this 5 times" — just press Run! Easy!
ch4.task: Press ▶ Run to walk across the bridge!
ch4.riddle: 🌉 The bridge has 5 boards! Press ▶ Run to take 5 steps across!
ch4.hint1: The loop is already there! Just press ▶ Run!
ch4.hint2: The number 5 means it repeats 5 times — one step per board!
ch4.hint3: Try changing "Hatua! 🦶" to something fun, then press Run!
ch4.errorGeneric: Oops! Something went wrong — the bridge is wobbling! 😰
ch4.errorNoOutput: You didn't take any steps! Press ▶ Run to walk across!
ch4.errorTooMany: Whoa, too many steps! 💥 The bridge is cracking!
ch4.errorTooFew: Almost there! You stopped in the middle! You need at least 5 steps!
ch4.outro1: You made it across! 🎉 The last board falls into the river behind you. The magic tree is right up the mountain! 🏔️
ch4.outro2: Well done! 🧙 One step at a time — that's the power of loops! 🔄 Kito will go with you to the top. Good luck, little coder!
ch4.outro3: UGH! 👾 You crossed my bridge?! Fine! But you can NEVER fix the magic tree! ...can you? 😰

ch5.title: Make Your Own Spell!
ch5.subtitle: Create your own code recipe
ch5.questHook: The magic tree needs YOUR spell to get better! ✨🌳
ch5.d1: You're at the top of the mountain! ⛰️ The magic tree is here — but it looks really sad 😢. To fix it, you need to make your OWN special spell!
ch5.d2: Look how far you've come! 🐢 You learned to TALK (andika), REMEMBER (acha), CHOOSE (kama), and REPEAT (rudia). Now let's make a SPELL with "kazi"! It's like writing a recipe! 🧪
ch5.d3: "kazi" means "recipe". You give it a name, put magic words inside, and then you can use it anytime! Like this:
ch5.d4: See? You make the recipe with "kazi ponyaMti()" then you USE it by writing "ponyaMti()"! Fill in your own healing words and save the tree! 🌳
ch5.starterCode:
# Make a healing spell for the tree!
# Fill in the magic words:

kazi ponyaMti() {
  andika("___")
}

# Now use your spell!
ponyaMti()
ch5.task: Fill in the spell with your own healing words!
ch5.riddle: ⛰️ The tree needs healing! Fill in your magic words inside the spell recipe!
ch5.hint1: Replace ___ with healing words like "Mti, pona!"
ch5.hint3: Any words will work! Just type something between the quotes!
ch5.errorGeneric: Oops! The spell didn't work — try again! 🌳
ch5.errorNoOutput: Your spell was silent! Fill in the words inside andika("___")
ch5.outro1: THE TREE IS GLOWING! 🌳✨💛 Golden light shoots up through the branches! Leaves pop out, flowers bloom, and all the stories and songs fly back to the village! 🌟🌟🌟
ch5.outro2: YOU DID IT! 🐢🎉 You made your OWN spell! You started by saying hello, and now you're a real coder! The magic tree is saved!
ch5.outro3: Wait... WHAT?! 👾 You fixed EVERYTHING?! ...Okay okay... maybe coding IS pretty cool. Can... can you teach me too? Pretty please? 🥺
ch5.outro4: And so the magic tree of Algoriti was saved! 🌟 But the adventure isn't over — there's a party to throw! 🎉

ch6.title: The Celebration!
ch6.subtitle: Use what you've learned!
ch6.questHook: Let's welcome everyone to the party — with code! 🎉
ch6.d1: It's celebration time! 🎊 The magic tree is healthy again! The village chief says: "Let's throw the biggest party EVER!" And guess who's in charge of the welcome? YOU! 🎉
ch6.d2: ME TOO! 👾 I used to break stuff, but now I wanna help! Let me welcome the guests! Please please please! 🥺
ch6.d3: This is it — the grand finale! 🐢 Use "acha" to remember a guest's name, then use "andika" to say "Karibu" (Welcome)! You know how to do this!
ch6.d4: Remember "acha" from Chapter 2? And "andika" from Chapter 1? Now put them together! Use + to glue words! Like this:
ch6.d5: See? "Karibu " + mgeni + "!" sticks the words together! Change the name to welcome YOUR friends! 🎉
ch6.starterCode:
# Welcome guests to the party! 🎉
# Change the name to welcome your friend:

acha mgeni = "Kito"
andika("Karibu " + mgeni + "!")

# Try adding more guests below!
# acha mgeni2 = "Shida"
# andika("Karibu " + mgeni2 + "!")
ch6.task: Welcome your friends to the party!
ch6.riddle: 🎉 Welcome someone to the party! Change the name and say "Karibu"!
ch6.hint1: Change "Kito" to any name you like!
ch6.hint2: Uncomment the lines below to welcome more friends!
ch6.hint3: Remove the # at the start of the last two lines to add Shida!
ch6.errorGeneric: Oops! The party's not ready yet! Try again! 🔄
ch6.errorNoOutput: Nobody heard the welcome! Press ▶ Run!
ch6.errorNoKaribu: Say "Karibu" (Welcome) to your guests! That's the magic party word!
ch6.outro1: THE PARTY IS ON! 🎊🎉 Lights fill the sky! Music plays! Everyone cheers as they hear their name! The whole village dances! 💃🕺
ch6.outro2: This is the BEST day ever! 🐢 Look at everything you did: you opened gates, remembered names, chose paths, crossed bridges, made spells, and threw a PARTY! You are an INCREDIBLE coder! 🌟
ch6.outro3: I can't believe it! 👾 I started as a naughty bug who broke everything... and now I can CODE! Thank you for teaching me! You're my best friend! 🥹💚
ch6.outro4: And so the village of Algoriti lived happily in code! 🌟 The adventure never truly ends... because there's always something new to build! 🚀 THE END! 🎬✨
